picks.title: Hackers exploit Cisco SD-WAN flaw to deploy custom KeyDrift malware
picks.summary: A newly identified advanced persistent threat (APT) group tracked as UAT-11473 was observed exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controllers, to deploy a custom malware framework called KeyDrift. [...]

picks.title: Polymarket halts trading after crypto-draining script breach, $2.5M traced
picks.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket temporarily suspended trading on Thursday after hackers compromised a third-party service to distribute cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript, with approximately $2.5 million in assets traced to a suspected attacker wallet. [...]

picks.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
Binance Drained of $5.5 Billion in Suspected Hack, Tether and Circle Freeze $1.8 Billion
picks.summary: An on-chain tally puts the suspected Binance drain at $5.57 billion across three blockchains, as Tether and Circle froze $1.8 billion.

picks.title: Open-weight AI models can exploit the patch gap
Claude Model Builds Exploits Across Major Browsers & OSes
picks.summary: An unreleased version of the AI model has found and chained multiple vulnerabilities in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux, Anthropic says.

picks.title: Polymarket pauses trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
picks.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.
